title: China's spending problem in 60 seconds
ticker: China's spending problem in 60 seconds: why its people won't buy, and why the world pays

scenes.title: China's spending problem
scenes.say: China's economy has a huge problem. Its people aren't spending. Here's why that matters, in 60 seconds.
scenes.speak: China's economy has a huge problem. Its people aren't spending. Here's why that matters, in sixty seconds.

scenes.title: Consumption in China
scenes.say: Consumption is just 56 per cent of China's economy. Most countries are at 70 or more. Even Japan, at its worst in the 1990s, was 10 points higher.
scenes.speak: Consumption is just fifty-six per cent of China's economy. Most countries are at seventy or more. Even Japan, at its worst in the nineteen-nineties, was ten points higher.

scenes.title: Slowing down
scenes.say: Growth has slid from over 10 per cent to under 5.
scenes.speak: Growth has slid from over ten per cent to under five.

scenes.title: Property: -20.6%
scenes.say: The property crash hit family savings. Property investment is down 20.6 per cent this year. So families save, and don't spend.
scenes.speak: The property crash hit family savings. Property investment is down twenty point six per cent this year. So families save, and don't spend.

scenes.label: Jan–Sept 2026
scenes.say: But factories keep running. The extra goods go abroad, cheaper and cheaper. China's trade surplus hit 938 billion dollars in nine months.
scenes.speak: But factories keep running. The extra goods go abroad, cheaper and cheaper. China's trade surplus hit nine hundred and thirty-eight billion dollars in nine months.

scenes.say: India's trade gap with China is about 112 billion dollars, and India has opened a wave of anti-dumping probes.
scenes.speak: India's trade gap with China is about a hundred and twelve billion dollars, and India has opened a wave of anti-dumping probes.

scenes.title: Beijing's balancing act
scenes.say: Beijing wants retail sales of 60 trillion yuan by 2030. Getting families to spend is the hard part.
scenes.speak: Beijing wants retail sales of sixty trillion yuan by twenty-thirty. Getting families to spend is the hard part.
